reviews.comment: Hands down the best professor I've ever had! Really cares about his students and his lectures are very engaging. This is the first time I haven't had to study much outside of class since everything was explained so well. Would definitely recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Best professor I had at TAMU, I took both STAT 315/335, his lectures were relevant to industry compared to other professors, including teaching us how to use Docker and Git. You can tell he thought about his course a lot and he does it out of passion. Also, he's one of the most caring and lenient professors, but please don't take advantage of it
Good professor. Genuinely cares that his students are learning. Low pressure quizzes and assignments, but they're geared towards making sure you actually understand the material.

Dr. Bruce is the best STAT professor I have had as a STAT major. He cares about you as a student. He is very understanding about student schedules and will extend homeworks if needed. The quizzes are the hardest part of the class. He actually TEACHES you in lecture and loves to answer questions. I wish I could take him for every STAT class.

amazing professor, his lectures are good and does his best to help people understand, and has easy assignments that also teach you a lot. only nitpick is that ta grading was a bit weird at times, but still an awesome prof

Scott Bruce is a legend. I took him for 315 as well. Overall very caring professor, who makes sure that class understands the material, and will bend the deadlines and quiz dates to make sure you do before you take them.

Very caring professor. Extends homework deadlines for midterms and structures his class so that everyone should succeed. Also is good at explaining concepts and helping students understand material. 100% would recommend!

Dr. Bruce is an understanding and caring professor. He has a very structured course, and never handed out any assignment/work out of the blue/last-minute. His exams are also low-pressure but enough to test the course content. 

His level of empathy for students is inspiring!

Scott is an amazing professor. He was very caring and made lectures very interesting! He made everything doable and not super difficult. He also cared how much homework he handed out because he knows that other classes can hand out a lot. I would 100% take this class again with this same professor! He made computational data science so interesting!

Love this guy. Super passionate about what he teaches and always asks for feedback about the data science content. Very easy homework in DataCamp and a few group projects that combine what you learn. He doesn't go super into-depth but will always answer your questions if you ask him. Take this class if you can!

Dr. Bruce is one of my favorite statistics professors by far! His lectures are always posted, organized, & recorded. His tests (open-note) are super doable for an A (given that you pay attention to his lectures/DataCamp). Only complaint is that we had 3 group projects of randomly assigned teammates, but the rest was a coder's paradise & stressless

What a great professor! His class was easy, yet he made sure everyone got all the things he taught. Assignments were a cakewalk. A nice person overall. Some "nerds" in my class had the impression that he wasn't very smart guy, well don't let his easy lectures fool you, he's a god in his domain of time series analysis and computational statistics.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr Bruce cares about his students. Most of his assignments are on DataCamp. He also gives some group projects which are easy. He explains every small details in the class.
